summary.text: Steve Yeager is a Democratic Nevada Assemblymember for District 9 in Clark County, first elected in November 2016. The legislature lists him as vice chair of the Legislative Commission for 2025-2026 and as a partner at Battle Born Injury Lawyers.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Yeager was born in Brooklyn Center, Minnesota, in 1978, and holds a B.A. in history and Spanish from the University of Michigan and a J.D., cum laude, from Cornell Law School.
He is a member of the State Bar of Nevada and the Clark County Bar Association.
Yeager began serving in the Nevada Assembly in 2017 and chaired the Judiciary Committee in the 2017, 2019 and 2021 sessions.
His page lists him on the Commerce and Labor and Ways and Means committees in the 2025 session and as a member of the Assembly Jobs and Economy Committee.
